request: Make the living room a cozy place to read with one comfortable, visually simple armchair and a book shelf. Keep the rest of the apartment empty. Use the developer’s drawn furniture as a starting idea if the plan is available; show a purchase preview with budget unconfirmed.

arguments.text: comfortable upholstered reading armchair visually simple cozy

item.name: Rivet Lawson Modern Angled Chair, Dove

arguments.rationale: Only one visually simple Dove armchair and one walnut bookcase create a reading nook along the living room's west wall near the window, facing into the room; all other rooms stay empty and all fixed structure stays unchanged. The supplied scene has no developer-drawn furniture and no plan retrieval tool is available. The chair's actual comfort needs a sit test. Budget unconfirmed; exact catalog total 140000 AMD uses mock prices, not retailer quotations. Door swings are unknown and sweep clearance is unverified. No sunlight performance is claimed. Trade-off: no dedicated evening reading lamp in this requested two-piece preview.

proposal.title: New furniture for the living room
proposal.description: I’ve added 2 new pieces to the living room. Catalog price: 140,000 ֏. The trade-off: a tight 12 cm gap behind the chair.
